description: SUPERSEDED — This schema is a duplicate. Canonical schema: schemas/agent_decision_record.schema.json (ADR-046). This file exists as a historical artifact of the feat/bdsl-foundation branch and MUST NOT be used for runtime records. Status: SUPERSEDED 2026-07-10 on feat/bdsl-activation-prep. See docs/audit/bdsl-fleet-coverage-2026-07-10.md and docs/adr/ADR-schema-reconciliation-decisionrecord.md.

record_id.description: Immutable primary key — UUID v4. Assigned at emit time; never reused or mutated (I-BDSL-1: append-only immutability).

agent_id.description: Canonical agent identity in the form agent:<name>:<semver>. E.g. agent:kyc-checker:2.3.1.

agent_version.description: SemVer of the agent code at emit time. Redundant with agent_id suffix but explicit for query convenience.

decision_domain.description: Domain of the decision — governs permissible stopping_rule values (e.g. PAYMENT and COMPLIANCE require full_search per §1.2 of pinned source).

timestamp_utc.description: Decision finalization instant — UTC, RFC 3339, millisecond precision.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace UUID tying this record to the originating request span. Same id space as correlation_id in agent_decision_record.schema.json (ADR-046).

entity_id.description: Hashed reference to the subject entity (customer/tx/account). Raw identifiers MUST NOT appear here (R-SEC: no PII in lineage fields).

input_hash.description: SHA-256 of the full input payload — enables replay without storing the payload. Format: sha256:<hex64>.

input_schema_version.description: Version of the input payload schema at eval time.

decision_space.description: The full set of alternatives considered. INVARIANT: D must contain at least 2 feasible alternatives (single-option decisions are prohibited per §1.2).

D.description: Alternatives actually evaluated. Must have >= 2 items (enforced here; business invariant: >= 2 feasible).

pruned.description: Alternatives eliminated before scoring, with reason.

criteria.$comment: MAUT criterion vector. APPLICATION-LEVEL INVARIANT (not enforceable in JSON Schema): sum(weight) = 1.0 ± 1e-6. Validated by the governance layer at emit time. Weights and target score ranges live in governance/novelty-pipeline-config.yaml — NOT in this schema.
criteria.description: MAUT evaluation criteria vector. Weights are runtime values, not hardcoded here.

weight.description: Criterion weight w_j in MAUT additive formula. Actual values come from governance/novelty-pipeline-config.yaml.

score_chosen.description: Utility score u_j(x_ij) for the chosen alternative, normalized [0,1].

method.description: Aggregation method. MAUT_additive is standard: U = sum(w_j * u_j).

U_chosen.description: Aggregate utility of the chosen alternative.

U_per_option.description: Map of decision_id → aggregate utility for all evaluated alternatives.

pareto_dominated_by_chosen.description: IDs of alternatives dominated by the chosen decision.

confidence.$comment: P(outcome=expected | context). Tier assignment (AUTO/REVIEW/BLOCK) is computed by governance layer using thresholds from governance/novelty-pipeline-config.yaml — thresholds are NOT encoded in this schema.

tier.description: HITL tier derived from confidence score. Tier boundaries live in governance/novelty-pipeline-config.yaml and .claude/rules/agents.md BUG-007.

stopping_rule.$comment: PAYMENT and COMPLIANCE domains MUST use full_search (§1.2 regulatory constraint). satisficing is permissible only for KYC, AML, CREDIT, ESCALATION domains. Enforcement is application-layer, not schema-layer.

applied.description: Stopping algorithm applied. full_search mandatory for PAYMENT and COMPLIANCE.

threshold_met_at_step.description: Which candidate (0-indexed) first satisfied the stopping condition.

exploration_ratio.description: 0 = immediate accept; 1 = full exploration of all alternatives.

regret_matrix.description: Map of decision_id → worst-case regret value [0,1]. Present when computed=true.

human_review.$comment: I-27: HITL — AI PROPOSES, human DECIDES. When tier=REVIEW or tier=BLOCK, required=true and reviewer_id/review_ts MUST be non-null before the decision is acted upon. Enforcement is at the governance gate (I-BDSL-2), not JSON Schema.

schema_hash.description: SHA-256 of this record excluding this field — integrity seal. Computed by the emitting agent; verified by the intake orchestrator.

prev_record_hash.description: Hash-chain link to the previous DecisionRecord for this agent. GENESIS for the first record.

emitted_to.description: Destination sinks this record was dispatched to (e.g. kafka:decision-log-topic, audit-s3-worm). At least one required.
